3D models and animation content company from Orem, Utah; the firm's exit line names CA (Computer Associates), whose Viewpoint Digital later went to MetaCreations. Since-year 1995; no named round.

Relationship-capital software (Ray Lane); New York in the firm's 2008 listing, Foster City as the Menlo book reads; bought by Hoover's in 2008. Vendor records put Kleiner Perkins in the Series A, but no citable source names it, so undetermined.

ASIC maker founded in 1979 and headquartered in San Jose, bought by Philips in June 1999 for about $1B (Wikipedia). No source names the round the firm entered.

Two-way wireless data devices, bought by Glenayre (the firm's exit line; 1997). Since-year 1991; no named round.

Chinese RSS reader (xianguo.com; Wei Zhou, Teams China on the 2012-14 pages). X1 provisional member. No current state or named round found.

Women's health and specialty personal care company in China (the firm's 2013-14 page; James Huang, a KPCB China partner), so flagged for X1. No source places it in a city or names the round.

Molecular memory for DRAM capacitors, Englewood, Colorado (the firm's 2008-10 listing). No source establishes its later state or names the round.

Local services marketplace (Chi-Hua Chien, iFund and sFund), later Kansas City.
